# Debrief: Argo CD

These clips cover Argo CD in practice: PR diff previews, an MCP server for AI-assisted operations, a GitOps adoption story with Argo Rollouts, FinOps automation, and a gateway migration pitfall. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s); [The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 7:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=472s); [From FTP To Argo CD & Argo Rollouts: An Adoption History Inside a Corp · 12:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wrek7kjrcs0&t=737s); [GitOps Your Costs: Automated FinOps Through Argo Workflows · 14:23](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5nVyVZSd0A&t=863s); [From ingress-nginx to Envoy Gateway at Zapier: The Benefits, Challenges, and Migration Lessons That Matter · 8:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kIj2U13VZJY&t=531s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Running a locked-down, namespace-scoped Argo CD with self-hosted runners gave roughly 5-second pull request previews across about 1,000 applications, with accurate output because the real Argo CD does the rendering. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s))
2. Templated setups (Helm charts or Kustomize rendered before Argo CD) need custom work for previews; one team cut rendering by only rendering applications whose root chart or values changed. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 12:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=777s); [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 16:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=976s))
3. MCP for Argo CD is a new open source server whose tools map one-to-one to CLI and UI actions, such as syncing, inspecting resources, and reading logs and live manifests. ([The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 7:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=472s))

## Action items

- [ ] Trial Argo CD diff preview on a pull request pipeline, using a namespace-scoped, slimmed-down Argo CD install and self-hosted runners, and measure preview time. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s))
- [ ] If you render Helm or Kustomize before Argo CD, limit preview rendering to applications whose root chart or values actually changed in the pull request. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 16:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=976s))
- [ ] If you put a new gateway in front of Argo CD, test encoded paths such as percent 2F, since normalization caused 404s for Argo CD and Vault in one migration. ([From ingress-nginx to Envoy Gateway at Zapier: The Benefits, Challenges, and Migration Lessons That Matter · 8:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kIj2U13VZJY&t=531s))

## Watch together (8 min)

1. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s) (1:19), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Lockdown-mode Argo CD and 5-second PR previews at scale.
2. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 16:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=976s) (1:19), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Practical tactics to narrow what gets rendered for previews.
3. [The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 7:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=472s) (1:19), Alexander Matyushentsev, Leonardo Luz Almeida: Shows what the Argo CD MCP server's tools can do.
4. [From FTP To Argo CD & Argo Rollouts: An Adoption History Inside a Corp · 12:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wrek7kjrcs0&t=737s) (1:19), Alfonso Ming, Meritxell Rodríguez: Clear GitOps framing and why one team chose Argo CD.
5. [From ingress-nginx to Envoy Gateway at Zapier: The Benefits, Challenges, and Migration Lessons That Matter · 8:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kIj2U13VZJY&t=531s) (2:27), Kalen Wessel: Encoded-path gotcha that broke Argo CD behind a new gateway.
